name: pull-cord
title: Pull-cord Bulb
description: Object: Light and dark mode switch. A pendant lamp that is a switch. Pull the acorn on its textile cord or ball chain: the detent resists and snaps, and the filament warms from dull red to white while the lamp sways. It can switch the whole page’s finish, the new one opening from the bulb.

docs:
Pull-cord Bulb is in tactile/pull-cord/. Open tactile/pull-cord-example.html to see it run; pull-cord.mjs is the class, pull-cord.css its look.
Load both or it renders unstyled: in a bundler such as Vite, import './tactile/pull-cord/pull-cord.css' next to the .mjs import (or link it in plain HTML), then construct it on an element as the example does.
Docs: https://tactileui.dev/objects/pull-cord
